artifacts.summary: Confirms the planner/implementation checklist shape mismatch and proposes a canonical, prefix-agnostic mark-completed/deviation-annotation instruction reusable across the three in-scope agent files and the two downstream tasks.

memory_candidates.content: When an implementation agent's plan-checklist mark-completed instruction assumes a literal title prefix (e.g. **Task {P}.{N}**:) but the planner emits free-form prose checklist items (- [ ] {Step 1}), the Edit match finds nothing and fails silently -- the agent proceeds without ticking any items. Fix by matching on the item's existing text rather than any assumed prefix shape, while preserving separate annotation-suffix wording (*(completed)*, *(deviation: skipped -- reason)*, etc.) which is a distinct, usually-already-correct concern.
